numbering.title: Numbering and IDs
numbering.subtitle: The app gives every record its ID. Formats can change until the first record is saved, then they lock.
numbering.formHelp: Numbers are issued by the database, in order and without gaps, when a document is saved. The prefix and counter lock once the first number is issued.
numbering.readOnly: You can see the number series but not change them. Ask Admin to add or change a series.
numbering.warnTooLong: The number would be longer than {{max}} characters. Use a shorter prefix.
numbering.noFyBody: Number series run per financial year. Ask Admin to open the financial year.
numbering.noFyBodyAdmin: Number series run per financial year (April to March). Open it to add its series; its 12 monthly periods are created with it.

docs.title: Documents
docs.empty: No number series for this year yet. Ask Admin to add them.
docs.emptyAdmin: No number series for this year yet. Use “Add series” for each document type, per GSTIN where the law needs it.

masters.title: People, parties and items
masters.body: Staff, supplier, buyer, transporter and item IDs are given when those lists are set up.

notes.never: IDs are never typed, edited or reused, even after cancelling.
notes.gapFree: Each series is gap-free: a number is issued once, in order, when the document is saved.
notes.limit: Invoice numbers: at most {{max}} characters, unique in the financial year.
notes.limitUnknown: Invoice numbers are unique in the financial year.
notes.lock: The prefix and counter lock once the first number is issued.

f.gstinHelp: Pick a GSTIN when each registration keeps its own series.
f.prefixHelp: Up to 12 capitals, digits, / or -. The year and the counter are added after it.
f.nextHelp: Start at 1, or continue after the last number used before going live.

err.next: Use a whole number of 1 or more.
